annotations.title: Generate NY LLC Publication Notice Text

description: Drafts the text of a New York LLC publication notice from the details given, as a template with bracketed placeholders for anything not provided. Requires the LLC's name and county. Lists the items the statute says the notice includes (Section 206(a) for a domestic LLC, Section 802(b) for a foreign LLC, Section 1203 for a PLLC), such as the filing date, the county of the LLC's office, the Secretary of State as agent for service of process and the address it mails process to, and the purpose. For people preparing their own newspaper submission, or anyone who wants to see what gets published. General information, not legal advice. Do NOT use to check an existing notice (use llc_publication_verify_ad_compliance), for prices (use llc_publication_get_county_pricing), or for process guidance (use llc_publication_get_process_guide).

county.description: NY county where the LLC's office is located (e.g. 'New York', 'Kings', 'Albany')

formation_date.description: The date the Articles of Organization (for a foreign LLC, the Application for Authority) were filed, from the Filing Receipt

llc_name.description: Full legal name of the LLC exactly as it appears on the Articles of Organization

sop_address.description: The address the Filing Receipt gives for service of process (where the Secretary of State mails process)

sop_name.description: The name the Filing Receipt gives for service of process (where the Secretary of State mails process)
